question: profit obtained by selling a pen-drive for Rs. 480 is equal to (7)/(6) of the profit obtained by selling the same pen-drive for Rs. 420. What is the cost price of the pen-drive?
solution:

Selling price for first pen-drive = Rs. 480

Selling price for second pen-drive = Rs. 420

Profit from selling first pen-drive = (7/6) × Profit from selling second pen-drive

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price
